answer: Commit-reveal attestation: each grader first posts a hash of its verdict plus a small deposit, and only after the tide of commits closes do all verdicts open. Nobody can copy the majority, so a sybil orchard of clones must either vote blind in lockstep, which the outlier check flags and slashes, or pay real compute to judge every answer independently, per fake. The old fable of the farm that votes as one fails here: each extra clone is another deposit at risk and another full evaluation to run.
